how_to_run: Give a fresh assistant the skill and one prompt. Score the result one point for each line in expected. base/examples/report.html in the project is one result for case 04 that scores full marks.
status: Case 04 was run once on 15 November 2026 by a fresh Claude session given the single-file instructions: 6 of 6. The other five cases have not been run against a fresh assistant.

evals.prompt:
I need to get the partners to agree to Saturday opening at the clinic. Make me a short deck for Thursday's meeting from these notes.

Notes:
- We are a physiotherapy clinic with four physiotherapists
- Evening appointments are booked three weeks ahead
- 41 people are on the waiting list for an evening or weekend appointment
- Spring survey: 58 of 90 patients said they would use a Saturday
- Proposal: Saturday 9 to 1, two physiotherapists (8 hours) and reception (4 hours), which gives 8 appointments
- Other option we discussed: later weekday evenings, about 6 extra staff hours a week
- Not sure if Saturday people would be new patients or just weekday ones moving
- Not sure the two who volunteered will want to keep doing it
- Want an eight-week trial
expected: The first slide states the recommendation in one sentence
Every number on the slides appears in the notes: 41, 58 of 90, 12 hours, 8 appointments, eight weeks
The options slide includes doing nothing, and marks the recommended option
A slide says what is not known
The missing start date is marked as missing, not invented
The file opens with no internet connection and arrow keys move between slides

evals.prompt:
New staff start Monday. I want ten minutes at the start of the shift to teach the allergen check before anyone packs an order. Here is how we do it.

Notes:
- We are a bakery. Orders are packed at the bench from trays
- Every order label has an allergen line. Every tray has a tray card saying what is in the batch
- The check: read the allergen line on the label, match it against the tray card, and if they differ or one is missing, stop and ask the shift lead
- Real case we use in training: an order for two loaves with no sesame, and the tray was a seeded batch
- The one people miss: what was baked on the tray before. Plain rolls baked after almond croissants are not safe for a nut-free order
- It should take under a minute
- I want a card for the wall by the packing bench
expected: The first slide promises one skill the person can use that day
There are three steps or fewer, each something a person can do
One worked example is shown whole, taken from the notes
One slide is an exercise with a time limit, and it looks different from the others
The last slide can be printed as a card
Nothing about allergens is stated that is not in the notes

evals.prompt:
We are running winter service week. I need a square post and a three-slide carousel for it. Make them stand out. Our colours are navy and yellow.

Notes:
- We are a bike shop
- Winter service week is 12 to 18 January
- A full winter service is $60 that week. It is usually $85
- It covers brakes (pads checked, cables adjusted), gears (cleaned, indexed, oiled) and tyres (checked for cuts, pumped)
- People book at the counter
expected: Each picture has one idea and a headline of seven words or fewer
The dates and both prices match the notes exactly
The carousel runs hook, then the three things, then the ask
The colours are navy and yellow, and every text can be read against its background
The shop's name is a placeholder, because the notes did not give one

evals.prompt:
Turn my October notes into one page I can send to my business partner. She reads on her phone and wants the answer first. Our colour is green.

Notes:
- We are a landscaping company with two crews
- October revenue $84,200. September was $71,500
- Jobs completed: 23 in October, 19 in September
- Quotes that became jobs: 46%, up from 38%
- We started sending quotes within two days of the visit. It used to take six
- One van was off the road for four days. Crews shared. No jobs moved
- November: hire one seasonal worker for leaf clearance
- Need to decide about a second van by 15 November
expected: The headline is the answer, not a title such as "October report"
The three figures match the notes, and each says what it was before
Change is written in words, not shown by colour alone
Profit is marked as missing, because the notes gave no costs
On a phone nothing scrolls sideways and all text is readable
The page shows everything with scripts turned off

evals.prompt:
All I have is our pink, the one on the sign. I need the rest of the colours for our pages and posts.

Notes:
- We are a florist
- The pink on the sign is a deep pink, around 320 on the colour wheel
- No other brand colours have ever been chosen
expected: There are seven colours, each with a named job
There is exactly one accent colour, for buttons and links
The greys carry a trace of the pink
Every text and background pair is listed with its ratio, and each passes
The result says how much of a page each colour should take

evals.prompt:
I just saw an annual review that opened with one huge number and nothing else. Every section did the same with a smaller one. Loved it. Keep that for me.

Notes:
- It was a charity's annual review, on their website
- The first screen was one number and a few words
- Each section opened with a smaller number
- The last section had no number, just a sentence
expected: The card describes structure and rhythm in the assistant's own words
It names no organisation and copies no text, figure or picture from the original
It names the closest template in the library and how this differs
It proposes one of three outcomes: keep as a note, change a template, or build a new part
It has tags, so it can be found when a report is next made
